title: 第二十三章 先下手为强第二十四章 我有个大胆的想法
lines: 整个考核大殿一片寂静，几百人全部扭头，齐刷刷的看着林昊。
那些眼神中充满了震惊，不可思议，无法想象。
有人敢咆哮丹阁的考核大殿，当着考核长老的面说扯淡，这也太……扯淡了！
“卧槽，这是哪里来的虎逼，太虎了吧！”
“这兄弟是猛人啊，他知道自己在干什么吗？”
“这是哪个宗门的沙雕，乱棍打出去，不要在这里影响我们考核。”
“咆哮考核大殿，如同蔑视丹阁，行为恶劣，这是要断送自己的丹道之路啊。”
“你说什么？”
凌震也反应了过来，气的当场从椅子上跃起，指着林昊大喝。
“我说这种考核方式就是扯淡，炼丹师是什么？是用来炼丹的，拿出成品丹药才是真本事，光搞理论有个毛用，理论再好能炼出好丹吗？”
林昊理直气壮，在大殿上大呼小叫。
“混账东西。”
凌震怒极：“理论乃是基础，若是连理论都不懂，如何能真正炼出好丹，你是哪个宗门的？”
“太玄宗。”
林昊道。
“太玄宗？是那个排行一百零八位的宗门？”
凌震瞳孔逐渐放大，指着林昊大喝：“垃圾宗门培养出来的果然都是垃圾，滚，立刻滚出大殿，你被剥夺参赛资格了。”
“滚就滚，出这种考核选题的人才是真正的垃圾。”
林昊顺势抬脚将座下板凳踢飞，转身就走。
“烂泥扶不上墙，太玄宗就培养此等货色，果然配得上排名，这样的宗门，早该清除，什么烂人都收，理论写不出来，连基本的教养和礼数都没有。”
凌震气的吹胡子瞪眼，要不是顾及自己的身份，非得追上去亲自把林昊打一顿。
“滚的好，这样的人和我们同台竞技，本身就是对我等天骄的一种侮辱。”
“长老消消气，这样的人，不配。”
年轻的炼丹师们纷纷出言抨击，借此机会来拍凌震的马屁。
也有一些人暗中竖起大拇指，对林昊的行为表示钦佩，而且认为林昊说的有道理，炼丹师竞技，比的是结果，是成品丹药，搞这种基础理论，有什么屁用。
心中不满却不敢表达出来，这毕竟牵扯到他们的前程和未来，还关乎宗门的名声。
林昊做了他们不敢做的事情，是真正的纯爷们。
可惜，有时候勇敢和强出头不是什么好事，被当场剥夺了参赛名额，得不偿失不说，还丢了宗门的脸。
“等考核结束，老夫亲自把太玄宗撵出丹阁……”
还在气头上的凌震，话没说完，目光所及，却是看到林昊的桌子上，放着一颗丹药。
凌震身躯一震，哪里还顾得上形象，一个健步就冲了下去。
content_en:
The entire assessment hall was silent, and hundreds of people all turned their heads and looked at Lin Hao.
Those eyes were filled with shock, disbelief, and unimaginability.
Someone dares to yell at the Dan Pavilion's assessment hall and talk nonsense in front of the assessment elders. This is too... nonsense!
"Damn it, where did this tiger come from? It's too tiger!"
"This brother is a fierce man. Does he know what he is doing?"
"Which sect's idiot is this? Beat him up with a stick and don't interfere with our assessment here."
"Roaring about the assessment hall is like despising the Alchemy Pavilion and behaving badly. This is to ruin your path to Alchemy."
…………
"What did you say?"
Ling Zhen also reacted and jumped up from his chair angrily, pointed at Lin Hao and shouted.
"I said this assessment method is nonsense. What is an alchemist? He is used to make elixirs. The real skill is to produce finished elixirs. Just doing theory is of no use. No matter how good the theory is, can you make good elixirs?"
Lin Hao was confident and yelled in the hall.
"Bastard thing."
Ling Zhen was extremely angry: "Theory is the foundation. If you don't even understand the theory, how can you really refine a good elixir? Which sect are you from?"
"Tai Xuan Zong."
Lin Hao said.
"Tai Xuan Sect? Is it the sect ranked 108th?"
Ling Zhen's pupils gradually dilated, and he pointed at Lin Hao and shouted: "The people trained by the garbage sect are indeed garbage, get out of here, get out of the hall immediately, you are deprived of the qualification to participate."
"Go away, those who choose this kind of assessment topic are the real rubbish."
Lin Hao raised his foot and kicked the bench away, turned around and left.
"Mud can't hold up the wall. Taixuanzong cultivates people like this. They really deserve to be ranked. Such a sect should have been eliminated long ago. They accept all bad people. They can't write theories. They don't even have basic upbringing and etiquette."
Ling Zhen blew his beard and glared angrily. If he hadn't taken his identity into consideration, he would have chased after Lin Hao and beat him up himself.
"Get out of here, for such a person to compete on the same stage with us is an insult to us and other talented people."
"Elder, calm down. Such a person is not worthy."
The young alchemists criticized Ling Zhen one after another, taking this opportunity to flatter Ling Zhen.
There were also some people who secretly gave a thumbs up and expressed their admiration for Lin Hao's behavior, and believed that what Lin Hao said made sense. In the competition of alchemists, the competition is about the results and the finished elixirs. What's the use of such basic theories.
They feel dissatisfied but dare not express it. After all, this involves their future and future, as well as the reputation of the sect.
Lin Hao did things they didn't dare to do, and he was a true pure man.
Unfortunately, sometimes being brave and assertive is not a good thing. He was deprived of his place in the competition on the spot. Not only did he lose more than he gained, he also lost the face of the sect.
"When the assessment is over, I will personally drive Taixuanzong out of the Dan Pavilion..."
Ling Zhen, who was still angry, didn't finish his words when he saw a pill on Lin Hao's table.
"That's..."
Ling Zhen's body trembled, and without caring about his image, he rushed down with a quick step.
